label: step-008
payload: Write a Python script called 'rename_map.py' that applies a list of renames as whole-word substitutions to 'inventory.py'. Write the rename list as RENAMES — a multi-line Python list with one (old, new) tuple per line, each line ending with a comma, indented four spaces, the first and only entry being ("add_item", "insert_item"),. Do not run it yet.
